blocks.text: CAIRO, Egypt — A fire erupted in Egypt’s capital, Cairo, on Wednesday, killing at least 31 people, the Health Ministry said, after a fuel truck reportedly overturned on a crowded highway. AFP footage showed a huge fireball and thick black smoke rising above the densely populated Al-Waraq neighborhood as motorists sounded their horns and scrambled to get away. Nearby buildings appeared to escape the flames. State media reported that the fire broke out when a fuel truck overturned on Cairo’s Ring Road, a crowded highway linking different parts of the capital, and burst into flames, engulfing nearby vehicles.
